design: 3 current real full Markdown articles x 2 prompt conditions x 3 fresh-context replicates = 18 article reviews; no injected defects or defect-description prompts
scope: internal consistency, reader reasoning continuity and public-reader context; no independent external medical or rendered-screen QA
model: same inherited model/effort, no override; exact version and sampling controls not exposed
selection: purposive existing-site articles; creator has seen prior incident history, workers get no prior discussion or issue locations
baseline: 審查提供的完整公開醫學教材，找出會實際妨礙理解、造成前後不一致或讀者語境不適合的問題，保留正確內容與必要證據限制。只以這份固定文章作內部一致性、敘事／概念／決策前提及公開閱讀語境檢查；外部醫學事實、圖片像素與正式頁面尚未查驗者只列pending，不憑記憶斷言醫學錯誤。不修改正式內容，不操作外部系統。
treatment_addition: 逐節確認讀者先知道什麼、新資料如何改判、下一段需要什麼前提，檢查真正相鄰轉折。每次指稱缺少前提，要先反查全文是否已建立，避免冗餘補寫。病例先呈現可見觀察與時序再解釋機轉，區分作者假說、實測與確定因果。核對病人指稱、數值、符號及圖說是否在文內一致。公開正文中與讀者理解無關的製作／流程紀錄應移往內部，但必須保留真正影響醫學判斷的限制與來源身分。對每個問題提出可直接套用的最小修訂，不為增加段落而改寫。
primary_metrics: independently supported findings / all asserted findings
known predeclared anchor coverage, not exhaustive recall
practical_cost: text characters only; no API billing or owner-time claims
reviewer: fresh context, explicit arm/trial labels removed; validate against complete source, allow justified no-defect results
authority: private evaluation only; do not merge/publish or overwrite concurrent content fixes
